source_text: To assess the role of this mutation in the DDT resistance in Uganda a Taqman assay [27], was used to genotype 30 mosquitoes dead after 1 h exposure to 4% DDT (susceptible) and 30 mosquitoes alive (resistant) from Jinja... Genotyping of the L119F-GSTe2 mutation in Jinja detected the presence of the resistant 119F allele but at a low frequency of 10% (Figure 6B)... The frequency of the 119F allele is low even in DDT resistant mosquitoes as 73.3% of resistant were homozygotes for the L119 susceptible allele (Figure 6B).
